tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H below 0.5, whereas the target is H=20. A slow-horizon measurement can distinguish and calibrate the proposed long-term reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon adaptation model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow amplitude and timescale needed to forecast at H=20.
The slow-horizon probe directly targets the consequential long-horizon ambiguity.
Fine short-horizon resolution is less informative about the proposed slow reversal.
It is irrelevant to identifying the horizon response.
